learning_objective: 🎯 Let us learn the magic trick of turning one thing into many things!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Singular means single or just ONE! When we talk about one boy, one cat, or one toy, we use singular naming words.
Plural means many! If we have more than one thing, we usually add a magic s to the word. So, cat becomes cats and toy becomes toys.

main_concepts.concept_title: ✨ The Magic es and Tricky Words
main_concepts.simple_explanation: If a word ends in s, x, ch, or sh, we add es to make it plural (like box to boxes). Some words are very tricky and change completely, like child to children!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Magic Plural Wand!
fun_activity.instructions: Make a paper wand with a big S on it. Point it at things in your room and say their plural names. Say one book, then wave the wand and shout two books!

quick_recap: ⭐ Singular means only one person, place, or thing.
⭐ We usually add s or es to make words plural.
⭐ Some tricky words completely change their spelling when there are many.
